clips.title: The story
paras: Fire Scar Shrine is a despoiled night elf shrine nestled in the southwestern forests of Ashenvale. Once a serene place of worship, it has been corrupted by demonic forces and turned into a blister of fel energy right on Astranaar's doorstep.

Located southwest of Astranaar and west of the Ruins of Stardust, Fire Scar Shrine stands as a grim reminder of the Burning Legion's lingering poison in Ashenvale. The shrine has fallen under the sway of demonic corruption, nurtured by servants of the shadowy Cult of the Dark Strand and the Shadow Council. Fel magic has twisted the surrounding earth into scorched rock, where roaming demons now gather in open defiance of the forest's defenders.
